name: zclass_world_set_virtual_partition
description: zClass_World::SetVirtualPartition stores the virtual-partition/clamp flag and initializes virtual area partitions when the flag is nonzero.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zClass world/grid source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x450510 validates storing the edx flag at worldData offset 0x50, calling InitVirtualAreaPartitions only when nonzero, ignoring that callee return, and returning 0.
The native smoke verifies the zero flag store without initialization and the nonzero path that triggers VAP statics creation.
